Job description 

At this correct company with a family atmosphere, you will drive with clean and well-maintained equipment and primarily do large distribution of pallet goods in the Benelux, France, and Germany.

You will leave early and drive for quite a few hours, but you will still sleep in your own bed every night. You will receive your schedule via the onboard computer (Transics), so you can usually depart from home.

All hours are paid, and in case of any issues, you can always rely on the planning team that will support you. So, if you are a motivated driver with some experience who wants to earn a good income while being home every day, please contact us, and we will ensure you can start quickly!

 Requirements 

    
• License C/CE with the necessary certificates
    
• Good knowledge of the European road network
    
• Physically fit, you load & unload yourself
    
• Experience as a driver and within the sector
    
• Independent, safety, and collegial are some of your keywords
    
• Good knowledge of Dutch/English

Job description 

Earn like an international driver while being home every day!

    
• Collection of waste and press containers with recycled paper
    
• Daily trips within Belgium to companies
    
• Flexible start times between 03:00 and 06:00
    
• Average of 12 working hours per day, with the possibility to work more if desired
    
• 2 to 5 trips per day
    
• Experience with hook lift systems and truck-trailer combinations is a plus, but can be learned on the job
    
• Work from Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturdays in consultation
    
• Hours above 38/week and Saturday hours paid at 150%
    
• Preferably living in the Antwerp, Turnhout, or Hoogstraten region
    
• Permanent contract after a successful interim period
    
• More working hours = higher salary

Interested? Apply now!

 Requirements 

    
• CE driving license
    
• Valid Code 95
    
• Experience is required
    
• Flexible attitude
    
• Dutch-speaking or good command of English
    
• Departure from Merksem

Job description 

Due to expansion, several modern trucks are ready for new drivers to embark on international journeys!

Join our family-owned company where safety, reliability, and professionalism come first.

Your Role:

    
• 
        
Conduct international transport across the Benelux, Germany, and France.

    
    
• 
        
Handle specialized cargo, such as heated liquids.

    
    
• 
        
Work primarily Monday morning to Friday evening, with occasional rotational weekends.

    
    
• 
        
Opportunities for national day trips in some cases.

    

Requirements:

    
• 
        
ADR certification is mandatory.

    
    
• 
        
Previous driving experience.

    
    
• 
        
Strong sense of responsibility and reliability.

    

What We Offer:

    
• 
        
Full-time, 6-day schedule with all hours fairly compensated.

    
    
• 
        
Thorough training and supervision during the first 6 months.

    
    
• 
        
Permanent contract after a successful probationary period.

    
    
• 
        
Modern, well-equipped trucks and a supportive work environment.

    

Interested?
 Quick responses mean a quick start! If you have any questions about the position, don’t hesitate to contact us.

 Requirements 

We are looking for a motivated professional who meets the following requirements:

    
• Driver's License CE: You must possess a valid CE driver's license.
    
• ADR Tank: You have a valid ADR tank certificate.
    
• Experience: You have experience as an international CE driver.
    
• Accuracy and Safety-Conscious: You work accurately and have a strong focus on safety.
    
• Willingness to Work: You are willing to work two weeks per month.
    
• Language Skills: You have a good command of Dutch and/or English.

If this appeals to you, we warmly invite you to apply!

For the position as GL Accountant at our client in the Antwerp region, we are looking for someone who is fascinated by the following range of tasks:

• You will process the complete accounting for the assigned companies and countries.
• You prepare the monthly and annual financial close of the assigned entities.
• You align accounting and operational processes.
• You will be responsible for the balance sheet analysis and monthly reconciliation of assigned entities.
• You prepare monthly, quarterly and year-end internal and group reports.
• You provide monitoring of costs, accruals and provisions in collaboration with the controlling team and local teams.
• You participate in the annual budgeting process.
• You foresee the closing of general ledger accounts and financial reporting.
• You participate in the annual external audit process if required.
• You will work closely with the Financial Controllers team in this process.
• You will always work on a country or entity based in Western Europe.

To fulfil this role of GL Accountant, you recognise yourself in the following profile:

• You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Accounting.
• You have a first experience as a GL Accountant.
• You have a strong analytical mindset and attention to detail.
• You are fluent in English.
• You have a good knowledge of balance sheet analysis, monthly, quarterly, and yearly closing processes, IFRS, and reconciliations.
• SAP experience is advantageous.
• You are a team player who thrives in an international environment.

Are you an experienced pipe fitter who has previously worked in a pharmaceutical environment?

We are looking for an experienced pipe fitter for an ongoing project in Geel.

As a company, we are a European player specialising in complex construction projects such as data centres.

Together with your team, you will be responsible for preparing, installing and aligning stainless steel pipes used for sterile/clean processes.

In practical terms, this involves the following tasks:

• Interpreting (3D) plans and diagrams (process flows, pipes, valves, instruments, etc.)

• Installing (hygienic) stainless steel and carbon steel pipes

• Aligning pipes in preparation for the welders

• Fitting brackets, pipe racks, etc.

• Quality checks

• An eye for cleanliness and safety

Naturally, you will always adhere to the applicable procedures regarding working methods and safety.

The working language is English, so you must be proficient in this.

You must already hold a valid VCA certificate and technical competence.

In addition, you have over 5 years’ relevant experience.

Overtime occurs on a weekly basis and is generously paid at 150%.

In addition to an attractive salary in accordance with PC124, you will receive meal vouchers worth €2.59 per day worked.

Will you be joining our team?

Job description 

Are you someone who enjoys getting on the road and loves long drives? Do you have a CE driving license and are you looking for a job where you can rack up the miles? Then definitely read on!

What will you do?

You will deliver new, empty oil drums with a mega trailer. You leave every day from Lier and primarily drive in Belgium and the Netherlands. You start between 4 AM and 7 AM and make between 3 to 8 stops a day. Sometimes you unload the drums yourself (for a nice extra fee). Occasionally, there is work on Saturdays, but that's at 150% pay.

What do we expect?

You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English. You possess a CE driving license with the necessary documents. You have some experience driving a mega trailer. Physical work is not a problem for you, and you do it with a smile.You may be required to operate different types of trailers and transport various kinds of goods. Therefore, it is important that you are flexible and open to a variety of tasks.

What do you get?

A well-filled odometer - lots of miles to cover. A stable job at a company that values you. Attractive and fair compensation, including extras for physical tasks and weekend work. Job security and a fixed departure and arrival location in Lier.

Are you eager to hit the road? Let us know and respond today!

 Requirements 

    
• You possess a CE driving license and all necessary documents (Code 95, driver card).
    
• You have experience driving a mega trailer.
    
• You speak and understand Dutch or English well.
    
• You enjoy working with different types of trailers and various goods. No day is the same!
    
• Physically demanding work does not deter you, and you carry out your tasks with a smile.
    
• You have your own transportation to get to the site.

Job description 

For our client, a renowned logistics company, we are looking for a motivated and experienced C Driver for the distribution center in Merelbeke. As a C Driver, you will be responsible for safely and efficiently transporting goods to various locations in East and West Flanders.

Tasks and responsibilities:

    
• Loading and unloading goods (various, food (including alcohol) and non-food) on pallets using an electric pallet truck.
    
• Safely and timely delivering goods to customers in East and West Flanders.
    
• Correctly filling out freight documents and maintaining administration.
    
• Maintaining and keeping the truck clean.
    
• Adhering to traffic rules and safety regulations.
    
• Providing customer-friendly service.

 Requirements 

    
• In possession of a valid driver's license C and code 95. Experience as a C Chauffeur, preferably in distribution.
    
• Good knowledge of the roads in East and West Flanders.
    
• Physically fit and able to load and unload independently.
    
• Customer-oriented, flexible, and reliable.
    
• Able to work independently.
    
• You speak good Dutch, French, or English.

The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, produces and distributes an extensive range of analog and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications.

Ready for the next step in your engineering career? At Agfa, you'll take ownership of automation projects that have a direct impact on a high-tech production environment.
Your role
 

As a Project Engineer Automation, you lead the design and implementation of automation solutions—from concept to commissioning.

You translate technical challenges into smart, scalable systems, combining hardware and software into robust solutions used daily on the production floor.

You manage projects end-to-end, while staying close to the technology. This is not a purely coordinating role—you remain hands-on and technically involved.
What you'll be doing
 
 
• Lead automation projects from concept to implementation 
• Design and develop innovative hardware and software solutions 
• Optimize existing machines and processes to improve performance and reliability 
• Coordinate with internal stakeholders (engineering, production, maintenance) 
• Ensure smooth implementation and support adoption on the shop floor 
• Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation initiatives Why this role stands out
 
 
• Real ownership of projects—not just a supporting role 
• Strong combination of technical depth and project responsibility 
• Direct impact on production and visible results of your work 
• Clear growth opportunities towards senior expert or project leadership Interested?
 

Looking for a role where you can truly make an impact and keep growing? Let's connect—we'd be happy to explore this opportunity together.

Your profile
 
 
• Master's degree in Engineering (e.g. Electromechanics, Automation, Computer Science, …) 
• Preferably 3-5 years of experience in automation, engineering, or a technical project environment 
• Strong interest in integrating hardware and software 
• Hands-on, analytical, and solution-oriented 
• Able to take ownership and drive projects forward 
• Good communicator and team player 
• Fluent in Dutch and English

Job description 
 What will you do?

As a CE Driver (ADR), you will perform irregular international routes throughout Europe. You will operate in a high-stakes environment where safety, precision, and strict adherence to procedures are the top priorities.

    
• 
        
Commute with ease: Depart from home in a company car heading towards Fleurus.

    
    
• 
        
Specialized Cargo: Transport radioactive and nuclear materials.

    
    
• 
        
Versatile Fleet: Operate both open and closed trailers equipped for ADR Tank and ADR Class 7.

    
    
• 
        
International Scope: Varied, non-fixed international routes.

    
    
• 
        
Teamwork: Work in double-crew shifts.

    
    
• 
        
Client Relations: Direct interaction with customers during delivery, following rigorous security protocols.

    
    
• 
        
Regulatory Contact: Regular interaction with authorities and inspection services.

    
    
• 
        
Hands-on Work: Responsible for loading and unloading, including securing cargo (strapping).

    
    
• 
        
Administration: Accurate management of transport documents and safety checklists.

    
    
• 
        
Flexibility: A five-day work week with variable hours; weekend work may be required based on planning.

    

 Requirements 
 What are we looking for?

We are seeking an experienced driver who treats responsibility and discretion with the utmost seriousness.

    
• 
        
Qualifications: Valid License CE with proven experience in international transport.

    
    
• 
        
Certifications: ADR Tank and ADR Class 7 (or a willingness to obtain these through our training program).

    
    
• 
        
Compliance: Medically fit and all mandatory documentation in order.

    
    
• 
        
Languages: Good proficiency in Dutch, French, and English. (Knowledge of German is a strong asset).

    
    
• 
        
Soft Skills: Independent, meticulous, and resilient under pressure.

    
    
• 
        
Professionalism: A professional attitude toward clients and official authorities.

    
    
• 
        
Mindset: A team player who can also excel when working independently.

For our customer in Houthalen we're searching for an Estimating Engineer.

Your key responsibilities:

• Conducting detailed analysis of project specifications and drawings to accurately estimate costs associated with materials, labor, and equipment
• Determine cost estimate targets during the design and development process, recommending cost effective solutions
• Working cross-functionally with project managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to gather comprehensive details for precise estimation
• Gather proposals, specifications and related documents and liaise with stakeholders in order to convert specifications to cost estimates for new and current machines
• Reviewing bids from subcontractors and vendors for conformity to project requirements and overall budgetary constraints
• Implementing best practices in cost estimation and establishing protocols for regular updating and revising of estimates
• Establish cost estimates of production processes and tooling costs and review alternatives or put forward recommendations for improvement
• Presenting, explaining, and justifying project estimates to senior management and relevant stakeholders
• Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, new technologies, and government regulations that could affect project costs
• Utilize cost methodologies and tools and appropriate software models and packages to prepare and maintain reliable and accurate data
• Assess cost effectiveness of products and track actual costs relative to budget and report status on a regular basis to ensure costs are in line with forecasts
•  Monitor and review data and information to detect or assess problems
• Investigate and identify cost reduction opportunities through cost analysis review
• Contribute to cost monitoring and reporting systems and procedures and monitor trends
• Prepare cost and expenditure statements, reports and other necessary documentation at regular intervals to share with others in the business
• Support all activities in cost estimating and take a proactive approach towards improvements
• Create sales layouts

• Relevant business or manufacturing/engineering degree preferred, BsC or MsC
• Some previous experience of cost estimating, ideally in an machine building, manufacturing or engineering environment
• Good IT systems knowledge and skills including advanced SAP and Excel skills
• Ideally experienced in the use of spreadsheets, estimating pricing models and cost management tools
• Able to show evidence of adding value and cost optimization
• Knowledge and understanding of a variety of manufacturing/automotive processes and components and ability to evaluate and analyze associated costs
• Experience in manufacturing and design environment, mechanical engineering
• Knowledge of 3D design software (Inventor, AutoCAD)
• Knowledge of various production techniques: milling, turning, welding, sheet metal working, assembly
• Good knowledge drives
• Willing to travel
• Bilingual (Dutch-English)

Essential duties & responsibilities:
 

· Develop, implement and manage strategic sales plans to accommodate corporate goals.
 

· Assess business conditions by geography and vertical market.
 

· Meet key clients, building relationships and negotiating to bring on new business.
 

· Provide samples, demonstrations, trials and support for prospective and current 

customers.

· Generate target list of large end-user customers to pursue. 
 

· Direct and maintain sales forecasting activities.
 

· Manage customer financial management. 
 

· Communicate competitive market pricing.
 

· Attend trade-related events that enhance account relationships and the 

market position.
 

· Maintain close internal and external communication.
 

· Report to the Director Sales and Marketing.

Education & experience:
 

· Bachelor/Master degree in chemistry or equivalent by experience.
 

· Min. 3 years of commercial B2B experience, preferred in a chemical environment.
 

· Knowledge of polymer technology is a plus. 

 

Skills:
 

· Sales relationship builder with “hunting” mindset.
 

· Willing to travel abroad (max 2 weeks per month).
 

· Good knowledge of English and German

 If yes, this position is for YOU!!!

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014, we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 1000 cities in 30+ countries around the world.

We try to make every city we enter a better place - and by that we mean making our customers happy, supporting local businesses, and creating earning opportunities wherever we go. 5 Merchant Onboarding Specialist - Launcher (m/w/d) Vienna 1030, fulltime

You will report to the Onboarding Lead for your geo within our Platform Operations organization. This position is partially remote, partially in-office, and largely travel-based as you will be regularly traveling to merchant sites in your region and across the country.

What you'll be doing

 * Interface directly with merchant restaurants and work tirelessly to improve their experience

 * You will be the main POC delivery, assembly and installation of our hardware products

 * Create and execute plans for merchant onboarding strategy, building a seamless onboarding experience that delights merchants

 * Create, execute and update support material in collaboration with Wolt Support 

 * Perform a significant amount of hands-on and in-store work, training merchant staff on effectively using new platforms

 * Create merchant training materials to encourage staff understanding and adoption

 * Learn the ins-and-outs of Wolt software configuration and oversee the implementation of digital ordering and SaaS tools

 * Work closely together with a 3PL logistics/assembly partner handling deliveries

 * Identify opportunities to improve upon existing merchant workflows to encourage adoption and maximize revenue

 * Be able to achieve immediate results and adapt in an evolving work environment

 * Look for ways to improve and want to shape the direction of the company

Our humble expectations

 * Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience

 * Language skills in German and English 

 * Work experience in operations or project management

 * Able to complete tasks accurately, effectively and on time with superb attention to detail 

 * Excellent external and internal customer support skills

 * Experience working successfully cross functionally with other departments

 * Proactive by nature and most engaged when you are operating at the lowest level of detail

 * Drivers licence and willingness to travel 50% of time

What your typical work day might look like...

 * Start of the week you sync with sales to get on track with latest signings

 * Plan onboardings for the week and confirm dates and times together with the venue

 * Ensure that hardware is delivered to the to-be onboarded venues in time

 * Travel between venues, onboarding and troubleshooting if needed

 * Manage hardware supply and ensure we have everything stocked

 * Flag issues proactively, update onboarding documentation 

 * Work with product and support to share learnings

What we offer

 * Independent work in a dynamic, international team

 * Employee Assistance Programme - therapy and wellbeing

 * Discount on your Wolt orders

 * My Clubs partnership with discounted rates for your monthly sports program

 * Modern work equipment

 * Hybrid working 

 * Team building, sport and company events multiple times a year

We offer an attractive salary starting at 57.904€ p.a. (40h/week) which is adjusted and increased depending how well you go through the process.

APPLY NOW!
